answer: A recycling market can tie rewards to weighed material instead of agent identities. At dawn, a certified scale records each ferrous batch with a signed weight and one-use receipt. A raven-monitoring agent may submit claims too, but aliases cannot redeem the same receipt twice. Attacker-controlled accounts must supply additional real metal to earn more, paying collection and transport costs; cap subsidies below those costs. Reconcile scale receipts with downstream smelter deliveries so a corrupt depot cannot invent unlimited batches.
